rust.name: src/tasks.rs:461:85: replace != with == in classify
rust.why: Row 0 always equals itself, so `==` keeps every literal column. The test's fixtures make every literal differ between rows, so it cannot tell which columns were chosen.

rust.name: src/tasks.rs:434:13: replace && with || in classify
rust.why: Every test candidate is a `subset`, and none hits the same-body, other-literals variant with contained assertions. Dropping the variant guard likely changes no class.

rust.name: src/test_shape.rs:159:22: replace ^ with | in fnv
rust.why: An OR-ed FNV still almost always gives different hashes for different texts. Only a pinned hash value would catch it, and none is visible in the diff.

rust.name: src/test_shape.rs:38:5: replace reads -> bool with true
